title: MACD: Multi-Agent Clinical Diagnosis with Self-Learned Knowledge for LLM

live_model.evidence: Methods: 'Qwen3 (235B, qwen3-235b-a22b), and GPT-5 (gpt-5-2025-08-07)'; Results: 'the gap between Llama3.1-70B (84.5%) and GPT-5 (86.6%) decreases'

prompt.location: All prompt templates are in Supplementary Information S14-S18

claim.metric: diagnostic accuracy (%) with MACD self-learned knowledge

data.source: MIMIC-IV v2.2 derived cohorts (credentialed PhysioNet access; DUA forbids sending data to OpenAI's public API)

notes: Multi-agent pipeline (diagnostician, judge, summariser) over MIMIC-IV notes; test-set sizes per disease not in the extracted text.
